1 मृ मरति म॑रते also P. मृइय॑ते (˚ति), pp.
मृत॑ (q.v.) die, depart from life. C. मार॑यति (˚ते) kill, slay,
put to death. D. मुमूर्षति wish or be about to die. I. मंरीमर्ति
suffer the pangs of death. — अनु die after (acc.), follow in death.
अभि affect or soil by dying. परि die around (acc.). — Cf.
प्रमृत & ममृव॑स्.

2 मृ मृणा॑ति pp. मूर्ण crush, destroy. — उप P.
(मूर्य॑ते) be destroyed. नि, प्र & वि = S.
